title: Structured union dataclasses + stream checkpointing for robust typed responses
creator: Asha Patel
description: Enable a schema-first, ergonomically-typed Python SDK flow that combines dataclass and pydantic union models with non-blocking streaming checkpoints and resume semantics. The goal is to make structured output parsing resilient to partial/streamed payloads, transient token-level retries, and connector-level fallbacks while keeping the developer ergonomics simple for sync and async users.
acceptance_criteria: SDK exposes a lightweight API for declaring union-typed response models using dataclasses and pydantic BaseModel interoperably
Streamed responses can be checkpointed every N top-level events (configurable) and reliably resumed after a transient failure without duplicating application-visible events
Backward-compatible behavior with existing typed-deserialization helpers: default field coercions and strict parsing available behind flags
Ship example notebook and quickstart showing async iterator consumption, checkpoint resume, and graceful fallback to text parsing when schema parse fails
Unit and e2e tests cover token-drop scenarios, retry-with-offset, and idempotent resume tokens
implementation_tasks: Design: small RFC describing union model registration, streaming checkpoint token format, and resume semantics
Runtime: implement checkpoint emitter in streaming client that emits small signed resume tokens every M events/tokens
Parser: implement combined dataclass <-> pydantic union hydrator with clear error surface and optional strict mode
Retry: wire checkpoint resume into existing retry/backoff layer so retried requests start from last committed checkpoint
Examples: add three examples: async iterator example, dataclass union example, notebook showing resume after simulated network drop
Docs: console/docs quickstart and API reference for new helpers and configuration knobs
Tests: unit tests for union discriminators, property-level coercion, streaming pause/resume, and integration test against local runtime simulator
test_plan: Unit: parse success/failure paths for each union branch, strict vs permissive parsing
Integration: run a streaming simulation that injects transient 500s and verify consumer receives no duplicates and resumes at correct event
Load: smoke test with 100 concurrent stream consumers to validate checkpoint overhead and latency impact
Fuzz: malformed partial JSON chunks to ensure graceful fallback to raw text handler
CI: add nightly test that exercises backwards compatibility with older typed-hydrator feature flags
rollout_notes: Feature behind python-sdk beta feature flag by default. Gradual rollout: enable for internal tenants, collect telemetry on parse error rates and resume success rate, then flip to default. Provide opt-out hook for customers who prefer raw streaming behavior.
